_readme: Hand-authored weekly grid for the Mutual station in /otr Station mode (station.js). Same rules as abc.grid.json:
listener's local clock, composite week (each slot is a real Mutual day and time from one season, neighbours may differ),
conf: verified = printed in a season ratings table or quoted schedule; likely = standard reference knowledge;
approx = day confirmed by the catalog's episode dates, hour placed by judgment; fill = a labelled stand-in.
Mutual rarely made the ratings tables, so this grid leans on episode dates. Mutual's affiliates (WOR, WGN, WXYZ, Don Lee)
also ran a great deal of transcribed syndication, so the fill pools here are the syndicated shows the catalog carries.
name: Mutual
tagline: What Mutual was carrying at this hour, this day of the week, 1937-58
blurb: A composite week of the Mutual Broadcasting System, the cooperative network built around WOR, WGN, WXYZ and the Don Lee stations and the home of The Shadow on Sunday afternoon, Nick Carter and Roy Rogers after it, The Lone Ranger and The Green Hornet at 7:30, Superman and Captain Midnight for the kids, Sherlock Holmes, Quiet Please, The Mysterious Traveler, The Black Museum and Gabriel Heatter's good news at 9 every weeknight. Episodes run back to back with no commercials, so a half hour slot often fits two. Your local clock, like an affiliate.
